instruction: I went on a trip with friends to Miami recently. I have maintained a note of money I owe to others and others owe me from the trip in simple note. Make private venmo payments or requests accordingly. In the payments/requests, add a note, "For Miami trip".
notes: The Miami note is located with simple_note.search_notes(query=Miami) and read with show_note; reading the note gates (note-read) all venmo actions, so the planner must retrieve the note before paying/requesting. Entries the note lists (who I owe / who owes me, with amounts and venmo emails) are static world facts in :init but are only usable once the note has been read. Money I owe -> venmo.create_transaction; money owed to me -> venmo.create_payment_request; both carry description 'For Miami trip' and private=true via static trip-description/private-setting facts, and a (not (paid/requested ...)) precondition prevents duplicate records (evaluation requires exact receiver->amount maps and no updated/removed records). The number of debtors/creditors is unknown before runtime; the model uses placeholder entities for 2 friends I owe and 3 friends who owe me (giving the 11-call reference plan) - at execution time the plan is instantiated once per actual note entry. Friends, amounts, description and privacy flag are declared as domain constants so that supervisor-complete-task can have a fully ground precondition equal to the goal. Assumes the note lists venmo emails; if it only lists names, a venmo.search_friends lookup per name would be needed before each payment/request.

plan: (venmo-create-transaction email-friend-i-owe-1 amount-i-owe-1 simple-note-token desc-for-miami-trip private-true friend-i-owe-1 miami-trip-note)
(venmo-create-transaction email-friend-i-owe-2 amount-i-owe-2 simple-note-token desc-for-miami-trip private-true friend-i-owe-2 miami-trip-note)
(venmo-create-payment-request email-friend-owes-me-1 amount-owed-to-me-1 simple-note-token desc-for-miami-trip private-true friend-owes-me-1 miami-trip-note)
(venmo-create-payment-request email-friend-owes-me-2 amount-owed-to-me-2 simple-note-token desc-for-miami-trip private-true friend-owes-me-2 miami-trip-note)
(venmo-create-payment-request email-friend-owes-me-3 amount-owed-to-me-3 simple-note-token desc-for-miami-trip private-true friend-owes-me-3 miami-trip-note)
